headline: Student List neck-and-neck with Vucic after ~150,000-strong Belgrade finale

sources: AFP (Straits Times/Gulf News) + Archive of Public Gatherings (crowd count) + NSPM & Ipsos polls + AP
fault_line: Poll credibility and what happens Sunday night -- 'Student victory is coming' vs. 'Vucic wins through fraud / will he concede?' High risk of post-election unrest narratives.

sections.what_happened: Serbia's snap parliamentary election Sunday Oct 25: the leaderless Student List (born from the Nov 2024 Novi Sad station-canopy collapse, 16 dead) is the biggest threat to Aleksandar Vucic's 14-year SNS rule. ~150,000 at the Oct 22 closing rally in Slavija Square (Archive of Public Gatherings via X; organizers claim 200,000). Split polls: independent NSPM -- Student List 44.5% vs SNS 42.7% (decided voters, Oct 20); Ipsos (commissioned by Vucic's own list, Oct 20-22) -- Vucic 47.4% vs Students 40.0%. Vucic resigned as president Sept 27 to head his list and seek the premiership. Six activists arrested in Belgrade/Novi Sad in the last 24h for alleged election-day riot incitement; campaign silence from midnight Oct 22 until polls close Oct 25 20:00.
sections.what_verified: AFP reporters on the ground; Straits Times; Gulf News (AFP); AP via EconoTimes/TodayNewsBrief (crowd 'hundreds of thousands'); IBNA (polls, 18 lists, 250 seats, 6,450,523 registered voters, 8,392 polling stations). NSPM figures via APT description.
sections.what_disputed: Crowd-size variance (150k independent monitor vs 200k organizers; Beta agency 'tens of thousands'); commissioned-poll asymmetry (Ipsos paid by Vucic's list vs independent NSPM); AP/Channel 4 footage shows scale, not votes.
sections.why_matters: A student movement that started over a collapsed station canopy could end 14 years of Vucic -- and the polls can't agree who wins. Lead with the two competing polls on screen, then the aerial rally footage.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- Serbia snap parliamentary vote Sunday Oct 25: Student List neck-and-neck with Vucic after ~150,000-strong Belgrade finale; split polls, pre-election arrests
